answer: Require each agent identity to post a bonded stake, locked for months and slashed on proven duplication. One honest identity costs little, but a Sybil attacker must fund every fake, so cost grows with each copy. Like a wharf that berths only ships that paid harbour dues, the network admits only staked identities; even at the nadir of a market crash the bond still binds because it is locked work credit, and a thin shale layer of free accounts cannot carry a fake fleet.
